coaching.title: Active Recovery + Light Strength
coaching.message: 17 days to the Julian Alps. Calendar has today as active recovery after yesterday's 14mi/2,000ft race-sim day two (32mi combined block) - keep it that way. 20-30 min very easy jog or walk, Zone 1, no watch-chasing, then a light Strength Session 1: single-leg work, hips, core. This is the peak of the block settling in, not a day to add load.

coaching.title: Fuel Right
coaching.message: You just banked a 32-mile back-to-back simulation with heavy carb and sodium turnover - today is about replenishing, not restricting. Aim for the ~220g carb rest-day target, push protein toward 1.6-2g/kg for muscle repair, and lean on anti-inflammatory foods (tart cherry, fatty fish, turmeric). Keep electrolytes going since you'll still be net-depleted from the block.

coaching.title: Recovery
coaching.message: Post-race-sim protocol: foam roll quads and calves, 15-20 min legs-up-the-wall, compression if you've got it, and protect an 8+ hour sleep window tonight. The light strength work is fine, but nothing beyond that - the adaptation from this week's peak volume happens on days exactly like this.

coaching.title: Mental Edge
coaching.message: Week 6, transition into taper - the hard work for Julian Alps is essentially banked. With 17 days out, the discipline now is doing less, not more. Use the easy jog to mentally rehearse the alpine climbs and technical descents you'll hit at ~2,500m vert - trust that the fitness is there and let it show up on race day.
